name: Brookside Plaza
summary: Brookside Plaza is a 226,107 square foot community shopping center in Enfield, CT, anchored by ShopRite and featuring popular retailers like Burlington, L.L. Bean, and TJ Maxx. Conveniently located near I-91, the center attracts over 3.3 million annual visits from the surrounding suburban community.
demographics: Brookside Plaza serves a diverse suburban trade area with an overall population of 36,563 within 3 miles and a daytime population of 32,399, indicating a strong residential and employment base. The center attracts middle-income families and working professionals who value convenient access to everyday necessities and value-oriented shopping. With over 3.3 million annual visits, the typical shopper profile includes budget-conscious households seeking grocery, home goods, and essential services in a one-stop shopping environment.
description: Brookside Plaza is a well-established community shopping center strategically located near the I-91 interchange at the intersection of Hazard Avenue and Phoenix Avenue in Enfield, Connecticut. Spanning 226,107 square feet, this open-air center serves as a primary shopping destination for the northern Connecticut region, drawing over 3.3 million visitors annually. The property features a strong lineup of national retailers including ShopRite as the grocery anchor, along with Burlington Coat Factory, L.L. Bean, TJ Maxx, Staples, and PetSmart, providing a comprehensive mix of shopping, dining, and service options. Managed by Regency Centers, a leading national retail real estate company, Brookside Plaza benefits from professional management and ongoing investment in the property. The center's convenient location, ample parking, and diverse tenant mix make it an essential retail hub for families and professionals throughout the Enfield community and surrounding areas.
